    Images of idempotents of Kronecker modules #

    The image of an idempotent endomorphism of a Kronecker module is a direct summand; it lies in C when the module does, and is finite-dimensional when the module is. These are used in Step 1 of the proof of Theorem 5.2. Also: S₋ does not lie in C, and S₋ as an object of D_fin.
